summary: Prospect Capital Corp filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an equity distribution agreement for an at-the-market offering of up to $400 million aggregate liquidation preference of its 5.35% Series A Fixed Rate Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock. The issuer may sell shares through A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners at market prices, with a 2.0% commission to sales agents. No firm commitment or minimum sale obligation exists. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation.
